messages:
maria: APAC edge saw a spike in mTLS handshake timeouts (~09:12 UTC). Error rate up and 504s. Started right after the kms unwrap RBAC rollout. Anyone?
kevin: that was my IAM change (iam-rollout-2026-03-23) at 09:05, tightened kms-unwrap bindings. I didn't expect perf hit.
sam: can we see proxy + kms logs for a sample request?
maria: paste logs: 2026-03-23T09:11:58Z proxy-1 tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: handshake failure
2026-03-23T09:12:01Z kms-client unwrap start request_id=abc123 target=hsm-01
2026-03-23T09:12:01Z kms-client unwrap done request_id=abc123 duration_ms=612
2026-03-23T09:12:01Z proxy-1 tls: handshake timeout (HSM unwrap 612ms)
kevin: 612ms unwrap is high. Could intermittent IAM denies cause retries/backoff and push up latency?
olivia: audit-bot shows deny spike at 09:06-09:13 for svc-edge-proxy@apac: 43 denied KMS:Decrypts, sample principal edge-proxy@apac. Policy change id matches.
audit-bot: ALERT: denied_kms_decrypt=43 region=apac window=09:06-09:13 policy=iam-rollout-2026-03-23
sam: that explains queuing. If unwraps are denied then client retries and holds the TLS handshake.
maria: mitigation: rollback the new binding for edge-proxy to previous role and let rotator use cached keys. Need approval.
kevin: rolling back to the previous role now (will take ~2m).
olivia: add an audit marker for rollback window (incident-3251234567) so SRE can filter logs.
audit-bot: ACTION: ticket INC-2026-3251234567 created and audit markers enabled for unwraps.
kevin: rollback deployed to apac-edge. Deny count falling.
maria: 504s decreasing, latency SLOs recovering. Good.
sam: follow-ups: 1) rotator code: add fallback to software-unwrap when HSM auth denied 2) circuit-breaker: if unwrap latency >250ms switch to cached key path 3) alert on kms deny rate >5/min. I'll open PRs.
olivia: I'll own runbook and audit-log enrichment. Add RBAC rollout checklist: perf baseline + quick-rollback step.
audit-bot: NOTE: incident closed to watchlist. Recommend post-incident review in eng-security tomorrow.
maria: filed follow-up ticket with PR links and test plan. Thanks all :thumbsup:
